timeline.subtitle: A structured, 6-month roadmap designed around what assessment bodies actually need to see.

steps.title: Gap Analysis & Training
steps.desc: We review your university transcript and existing skills. We then put you through an intensive bootcamp to master the specific software tools and workflows used in Australian workplaces.

steps.title: Commercial Project
steps.desc: The core of the program. You join a project team to deliver real, paid work for a client. You clock 400+ hours of verified, loggable experience — the exact format assessment bodies require.

steps.title: Portfolio & Personal Brand
steps.desc: We rebuild your CV to highlight your new experience. We construct your professional portfolio and optimise your LinkedIn and online presence so employers take notice.

steps.title: Placement & Reference
steps.desc: You receive a professional reference letter from your project lead. We connect you with our hiring network and continue supporting you until you sign a contract.
